LanguageData.DMSL_Hediff_WanderingEngineer.label: Wandering
LanguageData.DMSL_Hediff_WanderingEngineer.descriptio: This mech has received a signal from the mechanitor link and wandered near the colony. It is uncontrolled and will attempt to leave the map after a period of time.
LanguageData.DMSL_Hediff_PsychicCamouflage.label: Psychic Camouflage
LanguageData.DMSL_Hediff_PsychicCamouflage.descriptio: An invisible state granted by Omnimind Silence that masks psychic signals and makes units unseen by enemies.
LanguageData.DMSL_Hediff_ElectroshockStun.label: Electroshock Coma
LanguageData.DMSL_Hediff_ElectroshockStun.description: A coma state caused by High-Voltage Shock.
LanguageData.DMSL_Hediff_RadiationCorrosion.label: Radiation Corrosion
LanguageData.DMSL_Hediff_RadiationCorrosion.descripti: Massive radiation pierces flesh and armor alike, damaging cellular structures and electronics. Neither organics nor mechanoids can long survive such intense exposure.
LanguageData.DMSL_Hediff_BandwidthAmplification.label: Bandwidth amplification
LanguageData.DMSL_Hediff_BandwidthAmplification.descr: The bandwidth amplifier is providing bandwidth to this unit.
